thread:
julie-cs: Hey team, Acme Corp just asked two things in one message: 1) whether CVE-2026-12345 (transitive lib 'fastcompress') affects Hosted API or their Private deployment, and 2) whether our SBOM includes that transitive and if KMS key rotation will cause any downtime for their on-prem nodes. They need a remediation ETA and SOC2 evidence they can attach to their audit.

samir-sec: Quick triage summary: fastcompress <=1.2.3 has a decompression memory-safety bug. Impact at Redwood: artifact-uploader (used by private installers and some on-prem helper agents) pulls fastcompress via build-toolchain; hosted inference (API) does not directly use it. Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 6.4) — exploit requires crafted archive during upload.

owen-eng: adding a couple notes: 1) Our runtime image (serving) is clean — confirmed by image SBOM scan. 2) Private installer bundles include the uploader binary that links fastcompress via bundle-tool; those bundles are the only thing that needs rebuild.

samir-sec: Mitigation plan and timeline:
- Immediate: block risky uploads at the gateway for Private customers by toggling `reject-auto-unpack=true` (hotfix) — low risk. I'll post the toggle and rollout notes. :white_check_mark:
- Short term (48–72h): patch bundle-tool -> bump fastcompress to 1.2.4, rebuild private installers, publish patched on-prem artifacts. Target: 72 hours for full rollout to affected customers.
- Medium term (1–2 weeks): add CI SBOM gate to fail build if any transitive with >=5.0 CVSS appears in private bundle.

julie-cs: Perfect — can you also confirm what we can share as SOC2 evidence? The customer expects an itemized SBOM + audit log showing key rotation timestamps for the KMS key used to encrypt private artifacts.

samir-sec: Evidence we can provide today:
1) SBOM link for the affected private artifact (generated at build-time): `https://artifacts.redwood.example.com/sbom/private/installers/2026-03-13.json` (I will regenerate after rebuild).
2) Audit log snippet showing KMS operations for the customer-specific key (redwood-kms/customer-acme): we can export a signed log from our audit pipeline. Example query (internal):
```
# list KMS key versions and last rotation
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" \
  "https://audit.redwood.example.com/v1/keys/redwood-kms/customer-acme/operations?event=kms.rotate" | jq '.[] | {time, actor, key_version}'
```
I'll attach an exported CSV with timestamps and actor IDs for the rotation events. That should satisfy SOC2 item 6.

lina-cs: The customer also asked whether key rotation is rolling (no downtime). Will our rotation cause any service interruptions for their private nodes?

owen-eng: Short answer: rotation is rolling and backward-compatible for the current setup. Private agents fetch symmetric DEKs encrypted with the customer KMS key; we store key versions and accept previous versions for decrypt until TTL expiry. Rebuilds won't force downtime. Two caveats: if they rotate their own on-prem KMS or change key material outside our managed flow, they could temporarily lose access until they re-register the new key — we'll include notes.

samir-sec: Action items I will take now:
- Create infra issue #2389: patch bundle-tool + rebuild artifacts (ETA 72h).
- Post hotfix toggle and rollback instructions in #eng-oncall so on-call can flip `reject-auto-unpack` if needed (ETA 2h).
- Generate SBOM for current and patched artifact and upload to secure storage; share signed links with customer (ETA 72h).
- Export KMS rotation audit CSV and redact internal actor IDs to acceptable SOC2 format, place in secure share (ETA 24h).

julie-cs: Great. I'll reply back to Acme with the temporary mitigation and promise the SBOM + audit CSV within 72h. Also will let them know hosted API is unaffected. 

sec-bot: Deployed hotfix toggle `reject-auto-unpack` to staging at 1768679200.

owen-eng: FYI I already scoped a minimal PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bundle-tool/pull/452 — bump fastcompress to 1.2.4, add SBOM regen step. Samir, I can cut the release after CI passes.

samir-sec: Thanks. I'll own the customer communication for the evidence package. Pulling in @legal if they want to review the exported audit CSV before we send.

julie-cs: Thanks everyone — I'll update the thread when Acme confirms receipt. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
